# Ecclesiastes Chapter 9 -- Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-12

This log records all verses in Ecclesiastes Chapter 9 where the three translators significantly diverged.

---

## 9:1 — "both are before him" vs. "everything is uncertain"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "all [is] before-them" | Literal MT |
| LOGOS | "both are before him" | Traditional |
| PNEUMA | "everything that lies ahead is uncertain" | Interpretive |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted PNEUMA's sense — the point is uncertainty about the future.

---

## 9:9 — "vain life" vs. "vapor-life" vs. "fleeting life"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "your-vapor-life" | Literal compound |
| LOGOS | "your vain life" | Traditional |
| PNEUMA | "the fleeting days of life" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "fleeting life" — better for the celebratory context.

**Status:** All resolved.
